en: Now, before we dive into the actual content,
there is one small interface addition.
As Claude Cowork is under active
development,
this feature was added whilst recording the
course.
This Ask Before Acting or Act Without Asking
option is a very important one and another
safety feature implemented by Anthropic.
Ask Before Acting, which is the recommended
default setting, simply means that Claude
shows you a plan,
waits for your okay before any non-read
action. As mentioned, this is the default
setting and should stay the default.
If you change it to act without asking,
Claude executes immediately, so it doesn't
wait for your confirmation. This is a
risky setting on real accounts, like for
example, if you're working with emails With
calendars, files, browser sessions, all
those things we'll explore in this course.
Once Claude clicks, once Claude acts, it's
done. You typically cannot revert this.
Therefore,
it's better to keep Ask Before Acting as
selected option and only consider switching
for truly trivial
reversible tasks on data you don't care
about. There you can switch to the Act
without asking option.
One note maybe, we talked about that
deletion is an implemented safety feature,
so Claude always asks if it is allowed to
delete files. This is not affected by this
option here, so you still have some safety
features implemented.
I would stick to ask before acting for this
course and also in general.
